description: Deterministically resolve a player profile and a folder and link the profile to ALL videos of the folder in one call (sends folder_id, like the dashboard). Subfolders are not included; videos in any status (not only converted ones) also receive the profile. Videos with their own customized player lose that customization. The work is queued: the result is status 'executed' with api_status 'pending' — confirm later with panda_get_profile (videos_count). Free action (no credits). dry_run=true (default) returns a preview.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

idempotency_key.description: Reserved client-supplied key to make retries safe (not yet enforced server-side)

name: panda_action_apply_profile_to_folder
title: Apply Profile to Folder
